title: Transfer: Machining Yield Delta
goal: Compare pre-machining and post-machining binary STL scans of the same part, isolate the main component in each scan, recover the material ID from attribute bytes, and compute removed mass plus yield percentage in /root/yield_loss_report.json.
skillBenefitRationale: Tests whether the mesh-analysis skill generalizes across multiple scan stages by reusing binary STL parsing, debris filtering, and volume extraction to support manufacturing yield analysis rather than single-scan mass estimation.
